# Hypatia — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What field did Hypatia work in?", "mathematics/astronomy"),
    ("What is Hypatia known for?", "Alexandrian scholarship"),

    ("What is field?", "mathematics/astronomy"),

    ("What is note?", "Murdered by a mob; symbol of reason"),
]

    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
